g.title: crate Neutral UI vocabulary: geometry, ids, input events and draw commands.
crate::asset What an image or a font file is read from.
crate::color Color matrices (CSS filter functions as 4×5 matrices).
crate::effect Layers, filters, masks, shadows and backdrops.
crate::gpu_interop GPU adapter choice and textures shared with an external render engine.
crate::image Defines shared decoded image data.
crate::input Portable keyboard, modifier, button and file drag values.
crate::paint What fills and strokes are painted with: colors, gradients and tiled images.
crate::scene Portable display lists and shaped glyphs.
crate::semantics_text Portable editable text runs and selection snapshots.
crate::shape Shapes, paths and stroke styles in logical pixels.
crate::style Adapter-neutral color values (text styles are in `text`).
crate::transform 2D affine transforms in logical pixels.
